text:
Ravi: Taco truck outside main doors Tuesday 12:15? I asked the vendor, they can swing by. :taco:
Theo: yes please. split meal or team covers sides?
Ravi: thinking split + $50 from team social for napkins/salsa.
Priya: does the menu include vegan stuff?
Dana: vendor confirmed a tofu al pastor option, corn tortillas, and plain rice. they said theyll try to reduce cross-contact.
Eli: micro-trivia after lunch? 5 q, 10 min, silly prize? :thinking_face:
Theo: prize = mystery hot sauce + bragging rights. count me in.
Priya: thumbs up. two asks: nut allergies? easy access table?
Ravi: no nut allergies so far. table near elevator ok for drop-off.
Dana: i'll bring a small sign: "Tacos & Trivia here" and a folding table for condiments.
lunchbot: Poll: "Taco truck + trivia Tuesday 12:15 - coming?" React :thumbsup: to join, :thumbsdown: to skip. I'll post RSVP list at 11:30.
Eli: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Theo: :thumbsup:
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Dana: :thumbsup:
Ravi: heads up - vendor charges $1 card fee. cash pooling avoids fees.
Theo: estimate 10 ppl * $9 = $90. I'll bring $20 cash.
Priya: Venmoing $15 to @Ravi now.
Ravi: thanks! will hand cash to vendor.
Eli: volunteer to host trivia. will make quick 5 Q set (pop culture + maps).
Dana: bringing tiny speaker and a bell for answers.
Ravi: rain plan: move to 3rd-floor lounge; vendor can serve at loading dock.
Theo: remote folks can swing by 12:40 for pickup.
Priya: keep it mild spice, please no extreme challenges. :)
Eli: agreed, family-friendly only.
Ravi: final: vendor confirmed. see you outside main doors Tuesday 12:15. I'll post a reminder Monday night.
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Taco truck + micro-trivia" Tuesday 11:45 - I'll DM the RSVP list at 11:30.
